description: Several large plastic building blocks in blue, green, yellow, purple, and white sit on the bed near the wall. The left hand reaches in from the left toward the stacked blocks while the right hand steadies the cluster, then both hands pull pieces apart: the left hand lifts and removes a green piece from the top while the right hand separates and holds a blue piece, and the blocks are unstacked and spread out across the bed as both hands release and reposition them.
